title: Hung model requests time out and retry instead of freezing sessions for hours
notes: Night retro 2026-11-28: every Claude session on the machine froze together in six windows (~236 min; the longest 00:23-02:35 UTC). The machine stayed up; requests to the model simply did not answer (dashboard main sent one at 00:23:09, the answer came at 02:35:48). Wanted: sessions the app starts (worker panes, terminal and screen mode, and the project mains through the Agent SDK) get a request timeout so a hung request fails and retries: Claude Code documents API_TIMEOUT_MS. First verify it actually cuts off a stalled streaming request (not only a slow connect), then set it in the pane environment (environmentForPanes in src/main/command/pane-environment.ts) and for main's SDK session, with a value long enough for a long answer. If it does not cover a stalled stream, say so on the card and propose what would.
